description: Generate fictional US SSN-style test identifiers. Use for SSN test fields; use generate-fake-data for mixed-record fixtures. Returns a string for count=1, otherwise an array; structural validity does not confirm issuance.

formatted.description: Whether to add standard dashes to the generated identifier.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed for repeatable fake identifiers.

valid.description: Whether fixtures should pass the generator's structural validity rules, not actual issuance checks.

name: generate-ssn
title: Generate fictional US SSN-style identifiers
